Monbazillac was among France's first six AOCs, by the decree of 15 May 1936 (INAO, the ninety years exhibition); Jurançon was first recognised by the decree of 8 December 1936 (its cahier des charges); Bergerac is listed among the appellations reaching ninety in 2026.
